title: Effectively Engage with Stakeholders
coreMove: Stakeholder engagement becomes real when analysis, influence, and communication change tradeoffs under pressure, not when a register proves the phrase was memorized.

exampleSpecs.audience: a project lead who treats the stakeholder map as a finished document
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team may recite the principle while ignoring influence inside the next decision
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a peer reframes the PMI 12-principle language so Noella sees stakeholder analysis as decision contact

exampleSpecs.audience: new project coordinators learning the Seventh Edition principle set
exampleSpecs.stakes: learners may confuse stakeholder engagement with sending status updates
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the student's confusion becomes the teaching material for stakeholder analysis, influence, and communication

exampleSpecs.audience: a release manager comparing two versions of the same schedule process
exampleSpecs.stakes: schedule pressure can turn stakeholder communication into a late announcement
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the same release process appears before and after stakeholder engagement changes the tradeoff

exampleSpecs.audience: an internal reviewer checking whether engagement affected delivery choices
exampleSpecs.stakes: a complete file may hide the absence of stakeholder input under schedule pressure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the reviewer finds the telling detail in communication records after a baseline change

exampleSpecs.audience: a project manager noticing his own shortcut under pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: speed may be used to excuse skipping stakeholder influence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist works through wrong turns without dialogue and returns to PMI's behavioral standard

exampleSpecs.audience: a project controller allocating the final preparation hour
exampleSpecs.stakes: scarce attention before a review may go to polish instead of stakeholder evidence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the entire scene is the pre-action choice of where to spend scarce time before the schedule review
